prompt:
Now we are trying to compare following 4 popular classification models, i.e., Decision Tree, Logistic Regression (without regularization), Support Vector Machine (without kernel technique), Linear Perceptron, from different aspects. Please answer the following questions by choosing appropriate models from above models (could be multiple choices).

1)Which of these models is/are can only handle linearly separable training data  [A]

2)Which of these models can handle the categorical features directly and naturally     [B]

3)Which of these models can provide relatively reliable class probability estimation in theory [C]
response:
1) Logistic Regression and Linear Perceptron can only handle linearly separable training data. They are both linear models and do not have the capability to handle non-linearly separable data without additional techniques like kernel methods.

2) Decision Tree can handle categorical features directly and naturally. It can split on categorical variables without needing them to be encoded into numerical values first.

3) Logistic Regression can provide relatively reliable class probability estimation in theory. It outputs probabilities directly, which can be interpreted as confidence levels for classification.
